data.title: Ingeniero de Calidad
data.description: SOBRE EL TRABAJO Para los negocios de DASA buscamos un/a Ingeniero/a de Calidad en Longchamps, para trabajar en equipo por nuestro propósito: brindar salud a través de alimentos y bebidas, a la mayor cantidad de personas posible, cuidando el planeta. Vas a formar parte de un equipo clave para garantizar la excelencia en los procesos, promoviendo una cultura de calidad, mejora continua y trabajo colaborativo con las distintas áreas operativas. Tus responsabilidades principales serán Tus tareas: Gestión del sistema de calidad: Implementar, mantener y mejorar el Sistema de Gestión de Calidad (ISO 9001, FSSC 22000, HACCP). Soporte operativo: Dar soporte a las áreas productivas asignadas, actuando como referente de calidad en planta. Auditorías: Liderar auditorías internas y brindar soporte en auditorías externas (clientes, certificadoras y entes regulatorios). Gestión de desvíos: Liderar investigaciones de no conformidades y definir acciones correctivas y preventivas. Proyectos y lanzamientos: Participar como partner de calidad en nuevos proyectos, asegurando análisis de riesgos y cumplimiento de estándares. Gestión de indicadores: Elaborar reportes de calidad y dashboards para seguimiento y toma de decisiones (incluyendo uso de Power BI). Capacitación: Capacitar al personal en BPM, estándares de calidad y cultura organizacional. Trabajo transversal: Colaborar con Producción, Mantenimiento, Supply Chain e I+D para asegurar la mejora continua. SOBRE TI ¿Qué necesitamos de vos? Profesional graduado/a en Ingeniería en Alimentos, Química, Bioquímica o carreras afines. +5 años de experiencia en aseguramiento de calidad en industrias alimenticias, pharma o consumo masivo. Sólidos conocimientos en ISO, FSSC 22000, HACCP, BPM, herramientas de calidad y normativas vigentes. Experiencia en gestión de indicadores y análisis de datos. Manejo de Excel intermedio/avanzado y herramientas de visualización como Power BI (deseable). Inglés intermedio-avanzado. ¿Qué podrá diferenciarte? Alta proactividad e iniciativa, con foco en la mejora continua. Fuerte orientación a la cultura de calidad y a la excelencia operativa. Buenas relaciones interpersonales y capacidad para interactuar con múltiples clientes internos. Capacidad analítica y orientación a la resolución de problemas. Habilidad para impulsar cambios y generar impacto en la organización. Perfil dinámico, con actitud de desarrollo y aprendizaje constante. Carácter, criterio y determinación para la toma de decisiones dentro de su ámbito de responsabilidad, promoviendo el cumplimiento de los estándares de calidad y los objetivos del negocio. Capacidad para influenciar y desafiar constructivamente a los distintos equipos cuando la calidad, la seguridad alimentaria o el cumplimiento de procesos así lo requieran. SOBRE NOSOTROS Somos una empresa multinacional de capitales franceses presente en más de 120 mercados, líder en alimentos y bebidas. Operamos en Argentina hace casi 30 años, con 4 unidades de negocio: lácteos y alimentos de origen vegetal, nutrición especializada, aguas puras y saborizadas, logística. Nuestra estrategia global de bienestar es un pilar fundamental en este camino, al promover un cuidado integral de nuestros colaboradores basado en beneficios inclusivos, flexibles y personalizados, que se adaptan a las necesidades reales de las personas. Somos la empresa B Corp más grande del mundo, y tenemos un propósito: brindar salud a través de alimentos y bebidas a la mayor cantidad de personas posible cuidando el planeta. A través de este buscamos inspirar prácticas de alimentación y consumo saludable y sostenible. Con más de 3.300 empleados, +300 productos y presencia en más de 100.000 puntos de venta. El portafolio de Danone incluye marcas internacionales líderes, como Actimel, Activia, Danette, Danonino, entre otras, así como sólidas marcas locales y regionales (incluyendo La Serenísima, Yogurísimo, Ser y Silk). Nuestros beneficios: • Danone es trabajar con propósito: perseguimos un doble propósito empresarial de promover el éxito del negocio siempre de la mano del progreso social. Promovemos un espacio de trabajo diverso, inclusivo, sustentable y con compromiso con la comunidad. • Danone es tiempo libre adicional: ofrecemos días off "WellDan", semana off entre fiestas, semana adicional de vacaciones, día de cumpleaños. • Danone es bienestar: apoyamos la salud física y mental de nuestros equipos con prepaga, asistencia médica y nutricional, apoyo de almuerzo, Gympass y productos saludables Danone. • Danone es desarrollo personal: promovemos formación "on the job", con oportunidades de entrenamiento, mentoreo y desarrollo de las habilidades del futuro. • Danone es cuidado familiar: con licencias extendidas para cuidadores primarios y secundarios, lactario en oficinas y apoyo en gastos de guardería, alimentos y kits escolares. ¡POSTULATE! DIVERSITY En Danone valoramos la diversidad y fomentamos la inclusión, reconocemos, respetamos e incentivamos a cada talento en la búsqueda de ser su mejor versión. Todas las decisiones relacionadas con el reclutamiento, contratación, promoción, compensación, decisiones de desarrollo, capacitación y todos los otros términos y condiciones del empleo, se toman con una mirada inclusiva y diversa.

data.title: Packaging Associate 2nd Shift (2:00-10:30p)
data.description: About The Job Danone North America offers a strong benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Coverage, 401k Plan, Wellness Program, Life Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement, and Paid Parental Bonding Leave, among other benefit plan options. $1.00 Shift Differential About You Responsibilities: Conduct routine lubing, cleaning and inspection of equipment. Diagnose and troubleshoot problems to obtain maximum efficiency without sacrificing product quality and minimize waste. Operate forklift and supply Packaging, Filler Room and the Blending Room with necessary materials. Stock equipment with packaging materials. Operate SAP to print and apply pallet tickets, ability to perform flavor changes in SAP for palletizer functions. Maintain written records as required by federal and state regulations. Flexibility to work weekends, shifts, and overtime. Ability to follow specifications, policies and procedures to guarantee uniformity. Communicate with other shifts regarding current activities in process. Communicate with both upstream and downstream associates to maintain supply of product. Troubleshoot and correct minor issues with the case packing and palletizer equipment. Maintain an orderly, clean, and safe working environment. Participates/assists with equipment maintenance. Identify higher level mechanical issues and coordinate with Maintenance to resolve problems to minimize downtime. Requirements: High School diploma or GED REQUIRED Twelve (12) months or more of relevant experience required. Must be able to read and write, interpret documents such as safety rules, operating/maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Knowledge of Good Manufacturing Process (GMP's) Basic computer skills Ability to comprehend and follow simple instructions. Ability to effectively present information in one-on-one and small group situations to customers, clients, and other employees of the organization Must have the ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Possess the ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs. Ability to demonstrate superb decision-making ability to determine best course of action. Must be able to lift and move up to 55 pounds repetitively. About Us At Danone North America, you’ll work with some of the best-known food and beverage brands in the world like Activia, Silk, Two Good, Oikos, evian, and Happy Family. You’ll be part of one of the largest Certified B Corps™ in the world, working together to make sure our brands create real benefits for people, communities, and the planet. We have 6,000+ employees across the U.S. and Canada. Come join our movement for a healthier world: One Planet. One Health BY YOU. Danone North America doesn’t just welcome what makes you unique, we value it. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. All hires to our team are based on qualifications, merit and business needs. We recruit, employ, train and promote regardless of race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, genetic characteristic or any other protected status. Faithful to our values of openness and humanism, all of our employees share in the commitment to engage one another with dignity and respect. http://www.dol.gov/ofccp/regs/compliance/posters/pdf/eeopost.pdf https://www.dol.gov/ofccp/regs/compliance/posters/pdf/OFCCP_EEO_Supplement_Final_JRF_QA_508c.pdf #LI-DNP

data.title: Gestionnaire de projet - Transformation digitale (18 mois)
data.description: A PROPOS DE L'OFFRE Mission : Vous faites partie de l’équipe d’Amélioration Continue & Transformation Digitale à l’usine de Boucherville. Cette équipe englobe les fonctions Digitalisation, Automation et Intelligence d’Affaires. Au sein de l’équipe, vous êtes responsable de déployer la stratégie de transformation digitale Industrie 5.0 à l’usine. Cette vision de transformation digitale vise à maximiser le potentiel des équipes et des lignes de production à travers: L’automatisation des tâches à valeur non-ajoutée dans les différentes fonctions (production, qualité, maintenance). Une vision en temps réel du statut des lignes de production (performance, condition des équipements, qualité, etc…). L’intégration de l’intelligence artificielle (IA) pour soutenir l’analyse et la prise de décision. Plus spécifiquement vous assumerez les responsabilités suivantes: Conjointement avec l’équipe de direction usine et les équipes corporatives, définir la stratégie de transformation digitale pour atteindre la vision Industrie 5.0 de Danone. Bâtir les projets et les demandes en capital selon la stratégie définie, et les soumettre pour approbation. Exécuter les projets en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de l’usine et les équipes corporatives. Gérer le processus de changement avec les équipes durant le déploiement des nouveaux outils, et assurer la formation adéquate des utilisateurs. Assurer le maintien et la pérennité des nouvelles technologies déployées. La fourchette de salaire annuel de base pour ce poste est de 72,000.00 $ à 95,000.00 $ CA. Le salaire final offert sera déterminé en fonction de facteurs tels que l’expérience pertinente et les qualifications, l’équité interne et les conditions du marché externe. Danone Canada offre également une prime incitative concurrentielle à court terme et un programme complet d’avantages sociaux, y compris une assurance collective, des régimes de retraite collectifs, un compte de bien-être, des congés flexibles, un véritable environnement de travail hybride, un congé parental payé et d’autres options attrayantes. Dans le cadre de notre engagement envers la transparence de nos pratiques d’embauche, nous pouvons utiliser des outils basés sur l’IA à certaines étapes du processus de recrutement. Cependant, toutes les décisions finales d’embauche sont prises par des personnes. Cette offre d’emploi concerne un nouveau poste. A PROPOS DE VOUS Le candidat idéal possédera les qualifications et compétences suivantes : Baccalauréat en génie informatique ou dans un domaine connexe avec un minimum de 3 ans d’expérience pertinente en déploiement de technologies digitales dans l’industrie, ou DEC technique pertinent avec un minimum de 5 ans d’expérience pertinente. Capacité à formuler une stratégie et un plan de déploiement, et à respecter des échéanciers serrés. Passion pour les nouvelles technologies industrielles (automatisation, etc.). Compétences avancées en IA générative. Capacité à vulgariser les informations techniques et à les rendre accessibles. Capacité à gérer plusieurs projets en même temps, avec des ressources internes et externes. Bilinguisme français et anglais (oral et écrit) obligatoire. Le bilinguisme est requis pour ce poste, puisque celui-ci exige des communications fréquentes avec nos unités d’affaires, usines et partenaires d’affaires qui se situent à l’extérieur du Québec. A PROPOS DE NOUS Danone Canada est une unité d’affaires de Danone et œuvre depuis ses sièges sociaux de Boucherville, au Québec, et de Toronto, en Ontario. Danone Canada est la plus importante entreprise certifiée B Corp au pays, attestant qu’elle répond aux normes les plus élevées en matière de performance sociale et environnementale, de responsabilité et de transparence. D’une année à l’autre, Danone est reconnue comme l’un des 100 meilleurs employeurs au Canada pour son environnement de travail avant-gardiste et a reçu la certification parité Femmes dans la gouvernance pour notre engagement envers l’égalité des genres en milieu de travail. Nous avons plus de 500 employés à travers le Canada engagés et prêts à réaliser la mission de Danone : Apporter la santé par la nutrition au plus grand nombre, en travaillant sur des marques fortes telles qu’Activia, Oikos, Danone, Silk, International Delight et plusieurs autres. Joignez-vous à notre mouvement pour un monde plus en santé : One Planet. One Health BY YOU! (Engage-toi avec Danone pour la planète et la santé.) Danone Canada n’accueille pas seulement ce qui vous rend unique, nous le valorisons! Nous souscrivons fièrement au principe d’égalité des chances, tant pour le personnel en place que pour les candidats, quels que soient leur culture, religion, handicap, sexe, orientation sexuelle, identité, expression de genre ou âge. Fidèles à nos valeurs d’ouverture et d’humanisme, tous nos employés partagent la même conviction de collaborer tous ensemble avec respect et dignité. Notez que le masculin est employé uniquement dans le but d’alléger le texte. Nous encourageons la diversité et invitons toutes les personnes qui possèdent les compétences susmentionnées à poser leur candidature. #LI-NORAM #LI-HYBRID

data.title: Activation Intern
data.description: About The Job Support the planning, execution, and monitoring of activation activities to ensure all initiatives are delivered efficiently, aligned with defined objectives, and achieve targeted KPIs. The role emphasizes operational excellence, effective coordination with stakeholders, and performance tracking to maximize consumer engagement and overall business impact. About You Still an ACTIVE undergraduate or master's student from any major. Final-year student in Marketing, Nutrition, Management, or related fields Strong organizational, coordination, communication, and teamwork skills Detail-oriented, able to manage multiple tasks, and proactive in problem-solving Passionate about event execution, brand activation, and consumer engagement Able to start immediately for 6 months. Willing to be placed at Danone Head Office (RDTX Place, South Jakarta) with the work-from-office arrangement. About Us Danone's mission is bringing health through food to as many people as possible and we want to invite people to join the movement for a healthier world. We recognize the power people have to impact the world through their daily choices. Each time we eat and drink, we vote for the world we want to live in. data.title: ALTERNANCE - Planificateur Distribution Moyen Terme - Septembre 2026 - (H/F)
data.description: A PROPOS DE L'OFFRE A vos côtés, partout en France, depuis plus de 100 ans !  Chez Danone, grandir, on y prend goût. C’est pourquoi nous sommes présents dans le quotidien des Français grâce à ses 26 marques de produits savoureux pour se faire plaisir tout en prenant soin de soi et des siens.  Avec plus de 8 000 Danoners répartis sur 13 sites de productions, 7 entrepôts, 3 sièges et un centre de R&D, Danone travaille continuellement à l’élaboration et au développement de produits iconiques dans vos cuisines, supermarchés, restaurants, cafés ou encore pour des établissements de soins et des pharmacies. Certifiée Bcorp et Happy Trainees, Danone ne cherche pas à être la meilleure entreprise au monde, mais une entreprise meilleure pour le monde. Nous nous efforçons de proposer le meilleur à nos consommateurs comme à nos collaborateurs.   TES MISSIONS CHEZ DANONE :    Cette alternance se déroulera à Amphion les Bains (74500), dans notre usine de production d’eau minérale d’Evian à partir de septembre 2026. Noélie DUJANY, Mid Term Distribution Planner, dans l’équipe Distribution, t’accompagnera pour grandir au quotidien et t’épanouir dans tes missions : Réaliser le plan de déploiement des produits Evian sur 12 semaines pour les sept marchés. Respecter les contraintes logistiques des différents flux et ajuster en fonction des aléas. Alerter et proposer des adaptations dans une démarche orientée solution. Pour cela, tu seras en contact avec l’ensemble des business units européennes, avec les équipes transport, demand planning et planification de production. Participer à la mise en place d’un nouveau système de planification. Assurer le suivi des budgets et KPI supply. LES + DE CETTE ALTERNANCE :    Prime transport entre le lieu d’habitation à proximité de l’entreprise et l’entreprise. L’accès au programme "Vendredi je grandis" : un programme de développement et d'accompagnement sur mesure chaque vendredi après-midi, couvrant des sujets tels que la carrière, les soft skills et les hard skills. Avantages du site : restaurant d’entreprise, remboursement partiel des frais d’alternance (transport + logement), intéressement et participation, primes vacances, CSE La localisation au cœur du Chablais entre lac et montagne. L’ usine est ultra moderne, la plus grade d’eau minérale au monde. Ta rémunération dépendra de notre grille salariale en fonction de ton âge et de ton niveau d’études. A PROPOS DE VOUS Pour faire de grandes choses ensembles, nous recherchons pour ce poste quelqu’un de :  Disponible à partir de septembre 2026 pour une durée de 12 mois. De niveau Bac +4/5 en université, école de commerce ou ingénieur. Une expérience en supply chain est un plus ! Compétences/appétence : rigueur, organisation et capacité d’adaptation. A l’aise avec Excel/ERP, tu as une appétence aux outils informatiques. Une expérience avec PowerBI est un plus ! Anglais professionnel nécessaire (écrit et oral). Tu aimes travailler en équipe et échanger avec différents services internationaux ! A PROPOS DE NOUS Pendant ton alternance, tu préfères prendre des notes ou des initiatives ?    90% de nos stagiaires et alternants estiment que Danone offre un environnement de travail propice à l’évolution professionnelle grâce aux responsabilités, à l’autonomie et aux formations accordées (source Happy Trainees). REJOINDRE DANONE C’EST…   Rencontrer des Danoners aux personnalités singulières, profils divers et aux parcours professionnels variés  Grandir dans des environnements différents : sites de production, bases logistiques, centre de recherche et innovation ou encore sièges sociaux  Se construire un parcours de carrière sur mesure, adapté à ta personnalité, tes compétences et tes envies  Apprendre grâce à des missions responsabilisantes, riches et apprenantes.   Nos Danoners ont la parole ! Découvre le témoignage de six Danoners aux métiers et parcours bien différents : Vous n'êtes pas prêt d'arrêter de grandir. Tu souhaites en savoir plus sur le quotidien des Danoners ? Viens grandir à nos côtés et retrouve toutes nos actualités, conseils et informations sur notre site careers.danone.com, notre page LinkedIn ou notre compte instagram @danonetalentfrance. #LI-FR

data.description: SOBRE O EMPREGO Nosso time de Contabilidade está em busca de uma/um Gerente Sênior, para atuar na cidade de São Paulo (SP), de forma híbrida, e suas principais atividades serão: Liderar toda a função de Contabilidade (R2R), assegurando a qualidade, acuracidade e integridade das informações financeiras Garantir conformidade com normas contábeis (IFRS / BR GAAP), políticas internas e requisitos regulatórios Supervisionar processos de fechamento contábil (mensal, semestral e anual), garantindo entregas no prazo e com alto nível de qualidade Liderar auditorias internas e externas, garantindo transparência e mitigação de riscos Atuar como parceiro estratégico de Finance, traduzindo dados contábeis em insights para tomada de decisão Liderar e desenvolver equipes, construindo pipeline de talentos e promovendo uma cultura de alta performance Impulsionar iniciativas de simplificação, automação e digitalização de processos Garantir alinhamento com o modelo One DBS, promovendo eficiência, padronização e escalabilidade Trabalhar de forma integrada com áreas como Tax, FP&A, Controladoria e Internal Control, I2C, C&P SOBRE VOCÊ Formação em Contabilidade CRC ativo (Brasil) é obrigatório Experiência sólida em contabilidade em empresas multinacionais e/ou ambientes complexos Experiência prévia em liderança de equipes Inglês avançado/fluente Sólido conhecimento contábil (IFRS / GAAP) Experiência em fechamento contábil e reporting Conhecimento de controles internos e auditoria Visão estratégica e orientação a negócio Liderança e influência em ambientes complexos Forte capacidade analítica e mindset data-driven Foco em melhoria contínua e transformação Pós Graduação ou MBA são um diferencial Conhecimento em SAP é um diferencial SOBRE NÓS Na Danone, nos dedicamos para levar saúde e nutrição para o maior número de pessoas. E não só isso; queremos que nossa missão beneficie pessoas de todas as idades, em todos os ambientes sociais e culturais e em todas as partes do mundo. Hoje a companhia está presente em mais de 120 países, onde opera de forma ágil e simplificada. No Brasil, recentemente unificamos nossas unidades de negócio para atuarmos com sinergia, oferecendo um portfólio para todas as fases da vida: produtos lácteos e à base vegetal e nutrição especializada. Se você se identifica com uma personalidade ativista, otimista, pioneira e genuína, junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma companhia diversa e orientada para o propósito. data.title: Cold Storage Reach Truck Operator
data.description: About the Job At Danone, manufacturing the best products and supplying them to meet demand is a key driver for our plant teams. We are currently hiring Reach Truck Operators for our Logistics department, based in Dallas, TX. These are 12-hour shifts on a 2,2,3 work schedule. Both day and night shifts are available Job Summary: The Reach Truck Operator is responsible for operating a stand-up reach truck to move, locate, relocate, stack, and count product. This is a cold storage warehouse position responsible for operating heavy moving equipment, selecting the correct products from warehouse racking, labeling product using label technology, and delivering product to and from the dock and production lines in a safe and efficient manner. The Operator is accountable for the safe and efficient operation of the vehicle and may also be required to perform order filler and case picking duties. data.title: Internship: Medical Affairs - Epilepsy
data.description: About The Job Would you love to learn more about the field of medical affairs while applying your nutrition/ dietetic training to support key projects? Are you passionate about science, eager to collaborate with cross-functional teams to make an impact in healthcare? Then apply now and join us as our new Medical Affairs Epilepsy Intern in our Hoofddorp (DPA) and Utrecht offices starting August/September 2026. In this internship, you will be part of the Metabolics & Ketogenic Acceleration Unit. Our purpose is to advance innovative solutions for metabolic disorders and ketogenic therapies, improving patient outcomes worldwide. Your main responsibilities include: Assist in organizing external training programs for dietitians, equipping them to manage patients with drug-resistant epilepsy through ketogenic diet therapy. Support the planning and coordination of external congresses where Danone is represented. Represent Danone at commercial booths, engaging with delegates and addressing their queries. Engage with and support our country business unit. Contribute to one or two major assigned projects, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery. Discover how our team makes an impact every day - Tia's Ketogenic Story Meet your future manager! Your manager will be Clare Szwec, Principal Medical Affairs Manager. Learn more about them: Clare Szwec BSc RD | LinkedIn About You As a Medical Affairs Epilepsy intern, digital content management and dietetics/nutrition will be second nature to you. You’re proactive, share ideas, and work well both independently and in teams. You have a strong command of MS Office and exceptional organisational skills. Above all, you’re open and always eager to learn and grow. There are also some compulsory requirements: Enrolled as a Bachelors/Master’s student Nutrition or related field during the whole internship period; You are a resident of the Netherlands and hold a valid BSN number (if you are a non-EU citizen, you need to have a valid Dutch residency permit); Ideally available to start in August/September 2026 for a minimum of 6 months, 5 days per week; You are fluent in English - spoken and written; You are able to work from our Hoofddorp (DPA) and Utrecht offices, at least 2 days per week. About Us Working at Danone is a unique experience. It’s fast-paced and complex and, at times, it can get a little challenging. But it’s packed with opportunities to learn and grow working with some of the best-known brands in the world, like Evian, Alpro, Nutricia, Activia and Nutrilon. Bring your unique perspective, ambitions and entrepreneurial ideas to the table – the impact you could make might just surprise you. One Planet. One Health – BY YOU. We’re proud to be a B-Corp certified company. That means we meet the highest verified standards of social and environmental performance, transparency, and accountability in everything we do. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. As an Equal Opportunities Employer, we base our hiring decisions on merit, job requirements and business needs.* We Offer In addition to gaining invaluable hands-on experience at a large multinational organization, we offer: A competitive gross internship allowance of 650 euros per month (based on a full-time internship); Home working allowance of 2.40 euros per day; A public transport travel card covering all office-related travel; Hybrid working environment allowing for desired flexibility; Career advice opportunities such as workshops, seminars, networking events; International environment with 140 different nationalities in Danone NL; Active Internship community with 100+ interns across the Netherlands. What’s Next It’s simple – hit the “apply” button before the application deadline of 12 July 2026. In order to comply with GDPR we can’t process your personal data without your given consent, so please apply directly via this website. Good luck! We can’t wait to meet you. Need more information? Please contact Eugenia Bouzas, Campus Talent Manager, via eugenia.bouzas@danone.com * all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status

data.title: Hand Packer (Swing)
data.description: About the Job At Danone, Manufacturing the best products and supplying them to meet demand is a key driver for our plant teams. We are currently looking to hire a Hand Packer based in Springfield, OR! Shift Details: Monday - Friday (2:00 PM - 10:30 PM) This entry level position is responsible for packaging products manually, performing basic quality control checks, including accurate packaging, package counts, and weight, evaluating product and package appearance. Assembles boxes, applies labels, and stacks boxes on pallets. Places product on conveying systems and supports machine operators with basic material replenishments. In this role, you will be responsible for: You will prepare and packages products. Some duties include folding, taping, labeling, stacking boxes onto pallets, moving pallets with electric pallet jack. You will maintain clean and organized work area. You will Safely, efficiently, and accurately perform duties to manually move product through a production facility. You will follow standard operating procedures. You will engage in all safety, quality, and other company programs. You will understand and perform lockout tagout (LOTO) and other processes to assure safety for self and others on qualified machines. You will conduct self and encourage coworkers to conduct themselves in a manner consistent with Company mission, values, and code of ethics policies and other standards of conduct. Danone North America offers all employees a strong benefits package through a 401k Plan, Employee Assistance Program, and Paid Parental Bonding Leave regardless of if they are enrolled in Danone Benefits. Benefits for this position are through Local Teamsters 206. About You You will have a High School diploma or GED. You will have basic computer (keyboarding, email, data entry). You will have a minimum of 6 months of successful work experience that involves accuracy, dependability, and teamwork, ideally in a food production environment. You will maintain a safe working environment, functioning as a member of a cooperative team and safely perform job duties. You will be able to obtain company certification in the safe and proper use of an electric pallet jack. You will have the ability to adjust schedule to support 24/7 manufacturing, which may include working hours outside of a typical shift, including weekends as needed. About Us Danone U.S. is part of Danone North America, a purpose-driven company and an industry leader in the food and beverage category. You’ll work with some of the best-known food and beverage brands in the world. Our strong portfolio of brands includes: Activia®, DanActive®, Danimals®, Dannon®, evian®, Follow Your Heart®, Happy Family® Organics, International Delight®, Light + Fit®, Nutricia ®, Oikos®, Silk®, So Delicious® Dairy Free, STōK® Cold Brew Coffee ®, Too Good & Co™, and YoCrunch®. With approximately 5,000 employees and 13 production locations across the U.S., Danone North America's mission is to bring health through food to as many people as possible. You’ll be part of one of the largest Certified B Corps™ in the world, working to make sure our company creates real value for people and the planet. Come join our movement for a healthier world: One Planet. One Health BY YOU. Danone North America is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. It is our policy to give equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons without regard to legally protected characteristics, or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state/provincial and/or local law. data.title: Senior Manager, Benefit Operations
data.description: About the Job This role sits at the center of Danone North America’s benefits ecosystem owning annual enrollment delivery, strengthening vendor performance, and improving the technology and data flows that power the employee experience. You will partner closely with Benefits Operations, HRIS, Payroll, and external vendors to ensure our programs run efficiently, accurately, and compliantly. This is a high-impact individual contributor role with broad visibility across the organization. In this role, you will be responsible for: 1) Annual Enrollment Leadership Lead the end-to-end planning, implementation, and execution of annual enrollment Coordinate internal stakeholders and external vendors to ensure timelines, quality, and employee experience goals are met Manage testing, issue resolution, and post-enrollment improvements 2) Benefits Technology & Data Serve as the strategic and technical partner to Benefits Operations process owners Support configuration and optimization of benefits platforms (e.g., Empyrean, Ceridian Dayforce, SHARE) Strengthen data integrity by improving vendor interfaces, file transmissions, and audit processes Troubleshoot issues and maintain technical documentation 3) Vendor Strategy & Operations Manage relationships with brokers, carriers, and third-party administrators (TPAs) Support renewals, proposals, and RFP activities Oversee outsourced partners to ensure delivery against quality, cost, and performance standards Review and approve benefit invoices and carrier remittance processes 4) Process Improvement & Compliance Identify and implement process and technology improvements to increase efficiency and reduce risk Partner with Legal, HR, and Finance to support compliance and maintain audit readiness (ERISA, ACA, COBRA, HIPAA, etc.) Stay informed on industry trends and recommend enhancements aligned to business needs The salary range for this position is $120k-172k USD. The exact salary offered will depend on several factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, geographic location, internal equity, and market conditions. Danone North America additionally offers a performance-based bonus and has a strong benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Coverage, 401k Plan, Wellness Program, Life Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Time Off, and Paid Parental Bonding Leave, among other benefit plan options. This role is considered a “hybrid” position that allows for flexible work, meaning it is a role where collaboration with key stakeholders in Danone Hubs occurs. While you may have the option to work from home on a schedule as agreed to with your supervisor, you are also expected to regularly report to your assigned office location at least 3 days per week. About You You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with HRIS, Payroll, Legal, Procurement, Finance, and Communications, as well as external vendors and partners, to ensure seamless delivery of benefits programs. Required: Bachelor’s degree 8–12+ years of experience in benefits administration, HR operations, benefits technology, HRIS benefits, or healthcare/benefits vendor environments Demonstrated ownership of annual enrollment delivery Experience managing vendors, carriers, or TPAs Strong analytical and problem-solving skills (Excel proficiency expected) Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders Working knowledge of benefits compliance principles Preferred: Experience with benefits platforms such as Empyrean or similar Experience with HRIS systems such as Dayforce, Workday, or similar Familiarity with interfaces, file feeds, or data transmissions (e.g., eligibility, EDI, vendor feeds) Experience working within an outsourced benefits administration model About Us Life at Danone With approximately 5,000 employees and 13 production locations across the U.S., our vibrant culture and endless growth opportunities are just a couple of the reasons our employees call themselves “Proud Danoners.” Learn more about Life at Danone Our Brands When you join us, you’ll work with some of the best-known food and beverage brands in the world, including Activia®, DanActive®, Danimals®, Dannon®, evian®, Follow Your Heart®, Happy Family® Organics, International Delight®, Light + Fit®, Nutricia ®, Oikos®, Silk®, So Delicious® Dairy Free, STōK® Cold Brew Coffee ®, Too Good & Co™, and YoCrunch®. Our Purpose We’re committed to making a positive impact on our world. Rooted in our mission to bring health through food to as many people as possible, we’re proud to be the world’s largest B Corp. Learn more about our mission. Our Benefits Our commitment to making the world healthier starts with our employees. Physical Wellbeing: We pay for the majority of your medical benefits – which include medical, dental and vision – with our competitive 80%/20% cost-sharing model. Mental Wellbeing: Danoners receive fitness discounts, unlimited flexible time off and hybrid work schedules. We also have a range of programs that support mental health and substance abuse. Financial Support: We offer a performance-based bonus, a 401(k) plan, tuition reimbursement, employee discount programs and voluntary perks. Family Care: We offer caretaker benefits, 18 weeks of parental bonding, fertility, surrogacy, adoption benefits and pet insurance. Learn more about our benefits. Equal Opportunity Employer Danone North America is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. It is our policy to give equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons without regard to legally protected characteristics, or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state/provincial and/or local law. For our EEO policy statement and your EEO rights under law click here. #LI-NORAM #LI-HYBRID #LI-SM1 California Data Privacy Law
